summary: Tested the Family check-in change (it replaces the A/B/C reflection modules) on the backend and in the UI, using the public URL. Backend: new suite tests/test_family_checkin_iter145.py passed 11/11. (1) GET /api/case-settings now has setup_complete as a boolean. It is false for an unlinked parent and for a linked case with no update. It becomes true after a signed Align update with screening_offered true, and goes back to false with false. Both linked parents get byte-identical bodies. The top-level keys are exactly banner, set_by_label, features, template_categories, settings, plan_options and setup_complete, with no banned words. (2) POST /api/court-path/checklist returns items in the order case, family_checkin, card1, card2, card3, card4, biff. The Family check-in item is todo or done to match setup_complete, and it is identical for both parents. An extra 'modules' field in the body is ignored (200, no 422). No 'module' or banned words appear. (3) The checklist PDF contains 'Family check-in' and has no Module A/B/C, no old module names and no banned words. The requested-only PDF shows the exact note 'Showing your case, your Family check-in and the assessments your professional asked for.' (4) Court AI chat works without a modules field (200 after the AI notice was accepted), and a stray modules field is accepted. Regression: Safety Gate suites plus test_tip_history_and_court_checklist.py gave 80 passed and 3 failed. The 3 failures are the known framing tests that return 428 (AI notice), which E1 said to ignore. UI (Playwright, two real linked TEST parents via ui_seed_iter145.py): in the Court view, court-family-checkin is the first child of court-top, above court-menu. It shows 'Done' after the true update and 'Not finished yet' after the false update, and both parents see the same text and status. court-family-checkin-open is an <a> with href https://sacoparentsalign.online/, target=_blank and rel=noopener noreferrer, and clicking it opens a new tab. 'More court tools' opens with the subtitle 'Case code, Communication Builder, the bigger-picture tiles and your checklist.' There are no court-module* testids and no 'Court Modules', 'Child Needs & Priorities', 'Co-Parenting Dynamics', 'Conflict Readiness', 'safety' or 'screening' text. In the Self view, self-family-checkin sits right under the Self Journey header with the same text and status. Keyboard Tab focus shows a 2px solid #4a2574 outline. At 1920 and 390 widths the button is 44px tall and there is no horizontal overflow. Regression: the Court checklist card lists Family check-in second, and the Court Checklist PDF downloads as SA_CoParents_Court_Checklist.pdf. The other Self Journey cards still render.

issues: FamilyCheckinCard uses viewport breakpoints (sm:flex-row), but the Self Journey column is only about 340px wide. On desktop the card switches to a row layout inside that narrow column: the description wraps onto 4 lines and the 'Done' chip drops below the title. Consider stacking the card by container width, or passing a 'compact' prop for the Self view.

action_items: Optional: make FamilyCheckinCard stack vertically inside the narrow Self Journey column on desktop.

Optional cleanup: AlignmentHub.jsx ('Conflict Readiness' tile) and GuidedJourneyModal.jsx are not mounted anywhere (dead code). JourneyShell.jsx still defines PRIMARY_MODULES with the old A/B/C titles for its completion logic. None of this is visible, but removing it avoids accidental re-exposure.
critical_code_review_comments: combine() sets setup_complete = all(...) across a parent's cases. A parent in 2 cases sees 'Not finished yet' until both are set up. The other parent in one shared case may be in a different set of cases, so the two parents could see different statuses. In the normal one-case flow they are identical (verified).

AlignLinkCode.jsx hardcodes 'sacoparentsalign.com', while the Align site used elsewhere is sacoparentsalign.online (REACT_APP_ALIGN_URL / ALIGN_SITE_URL). This looks like a separate, existing inconsistency.

The FamilyCheckinCard status chip is hidden while case-settings is loading, or if the call fails (settings null). There is no error state, so the card just shows no status. This is acceptable but silent.

success_rate.backend: 100% (11/11 new; regression 80 passed, 3 known 428 failures unrelated to this change)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST parents, a TEST professional and a case through the app's own linking flow. All of it was cleaned up: the pytest fixture teardown, plus 'python ui_seed_iter145.py cleanup' (3 users removed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run 'cd /app/backend/tests && python ui_seed_iter145.py setup', then 'python ui_seed_iter145.py set true|false' (each run sends the next version as a signed professional/standard update), then 'python ui_seed_iter145.py cleanup'. This gives two linked parents for UI checks of the Family check-in card. Log in via /login (login-show-email-toggle, login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit-button), then open '/' and use the door-court and door-self doors. The portal remembers the last door, so use the Back button to return to the doors. The webhook secret is only loaded via dotenv inside test_safety_gate_iter144_full.py and is never printed.
